objective: A criterion with an absolute word needs a closed oracle; the word must stand alone, in English or Portuguese.

criteria.text: The absolute words are found as whole words, in either language
A word that only contains one of them is not found

fails: a criterion with an absolute word accepted without an oracle; a false alarm on a longer word; a regression
env: Node 24 and the standard library; the proof runs with node --test in a copy of this folder
output: the verdict of the critic on the issue
